basic_info.description: Situated just a few blocks from vibrant Castro, this stunning Victorian home blends timeless charm with modern livability, all while nestled in this incredibly central location. Showcasing beautiful updates throughout, this ideal floor plan features an open living and dining that flows seamlessly to a sunlit deck and beautifully landscaped, low-maintenance garden and turf lawnperfect for relaxing or entertaining! Steps away, a sleek remodeled kitchen along with two south-facing, sun-filled bedrooms and stylish bath, completes the main level. Upstairs, a bonus attic room makes for a perfect 3rd bed/office/guest quarters. Additionally, the basement level of this home has been recently expanded on, providing an additional flexible room, along with a separate utility room w/laundry area and 1-car garage. Only a few minutes to shopping, cafes, local hotspots, grocery and Kite Hill Park, plus MUNI less than a block away, this home is truly a must see.
